data.name: Alice
data.message: Scan's done, heading to upper engine.

I found Frank's body in electrical. I started in lower engine, went through storage, and then into medbay. While I was in medbay with Alice, I saw Bob walk in FROM electrical, and then he headed down to storage. Right after Bob left, I walked into electrical and found Frank dead. Bob is extremely suspicious since he was just in the room where the body was. Alice, you were in medbay with me, so you should be able to vouch that Bob came from electrical. I think Bob is our Duck.

I can definitely back up almost everything Charlie just said. My route this round was weapons, then cafeteria, and then down into medbay. 

While I was in medbay, I saw Charlie walk in from storage at tick 8. Then, at tick 9, I saw Bob leave medbay heading down towards storage. I didn't actually see the exact moment Bob walked *out* of electrical, but I can 100% confirm he was in medbay with us and took that path to storage exactly when Charlie said he did. 

Since Charlie's timeline matches my own observations perfectly, I'm inclined to believe him about finding the body in electrical right after Bob left the area. Bob, you have a lot of explaining to do. I want to hear what you were doing on that side of the map, but right now you are definitely our prime suspect.

Okay, everyone slow down — Charlie is twisting this hard. Yes, I was in electrical. I'll own that right now because I have nothing to hide. My route was upper engine, then medbay, then I popped into electrical to do the wiring task, then back through medbay where I saw both Alice and Charlie, and then down to storage where I am now.

Here's the thing: Frank was ALIVE when I left electrical. I saw him in there working, I finished my wiring, and I headed back to medbay. That's when Alice saw me leave toward storage — she just confirmed my timing.

Now think about what Charlie just told you. He says he walked into electrical *right after* me and *immediately* found the body. That's awfully convenient. Charlie, you're the one who actually entered the room with Frank's body — alone. You could just as easily have killed him the second I left and then run back screaming "Bob did it." That is the textbook self-report play.

Alice, you saw me come INTO medbay from that direction, but you did NOT see Frank dead, and you did NOT see who was in electrical between me leaving and Charlie arriving. Charlie had the window, not me — I was already with you two in medbay.

I'm not voting Charlie blindly yet, but I am NOT the Duck, and Charlie's story has a giant gap he's trying to paper over by pointing at me. Let's hear from Diana and Eve before anyone locks in a vote.

I started in storage, went to lower engine, and then headed up to upper engine to do my task. Interestingly, I didn't cross paths with anyone on my route until Alice walked into upper engine right as this meeting was called. Since I didn't see Charlie between lower engine and storage, or Bob in upper engine, they must have moved through those areas before I got there.

Right now, this is a massive he-said-she-said between Bob and Charlie. Bob openly admits he was the last person with Frank in electrical before leaving, which is incredibly risky if he's the Duck—but it's also the exact truth a Goose would tell. On the other hand, Charlie walking in right behind Bob and immediately finding the body is exactly how a self-report frame job works. 

Alice's timeline confirms they were both in the medbay area around tick 8 and 9, but it doesn't prove who swung the knife in electrical. With 5 of us alive and 1 Duck, a wrong vote puts us in a really dangerous spot. I don't think we can blindly guess on a 50/50 today. Let's hear what Eve has to add, but I'm leaning toward skipping so we don't accidentally hand the Duck a win.

I started in navigation, made my way through storage, and had just arrived in medbay to do my scan when the meeting was called. I actually haven't crossed paths with a single person this entire round, so unfortunately, I was nowhere near electrical and can't confirm or deny anyone's timeline. 

This is a textbook 1v1 between Bob and Charlie. Charlie is claiming Bob did it and fled, while Bob is claiming Charlie walked in right after him and self-reported. Alice's testimony confirms that Bob and Charlie were both exactly where they said they were around medbay, but it doesn't help us figure out who actually swung the knife in electrical since she didn't see into the room.

Also, Diana mentioned seeing Alice in upper engine right as the meeting was called, while Alice said she ended in medbay. That's a slight discrepancy we might want to keep an eye on, but the main issue right now is the body in electrical.

I agree completely with Diana. We have 5 people alive and 1 Duck. If we flip a coin on this 50/50 and vote out an innocent Goose, we give the Duck a massive advantage. We have enough numbers to absorb a skip today and force the Duck to make another move. Let's stick together in pairs next round so no one is alone. I'm skipping.
Bob
skip

Look, I get that Charlie's story sounds compelling on the surface, but I want to add one more thing that I didn't emphasize enough. When I was in electrical doing the wiring task, Frank was IN there with me, alive and working. I left him alive. The window between me leaving electrical and Charlie "discovering" the body is razor thin — and Charlie is the only person who actually entered that room in that gap.

Eve, Diana — I hear you on the skip, and honestly I think that's the safest play right now. A wrong vote on me hands the Duck the game, because I'm telling you straight up I'm a Goose. But a wrong vote on Charlie also hurts us if he's clean. The difference is: Charlie is the one rushing to lock in a vote on me with a story that has a self-report-shaped hole in it.

I'm also a little uneasy about that Alice/Diana discrepancy Eve pointed out — Alice said she ended in medbay, but Diana says Alice walked into upper engine right as the meeting was called. That's worth remembering next round.

I'm skipping this vote. Let's regroup, pair up, and watch Charlie closely next round. If another body drops near him, we know.
skip

data.name: Diana
data.message: Going to medbay, Charlie!

I found Eve's body in Oxygen. I started in Medbay where I saw Alice, passed through Cafeteria, and when I walked into Oxygen, Bob was standing right there next to the body! Bob, what were you doing? Did you just kill her or did you walk in at the same time? Because finding you alone with a fresh body looks incredibly suspicious. I need to hear your explanation, but right now you are my top suspect.

Charlie, your story has a massive hole in it. You just claimed you started in Medbay and saw me there this round. That is completely false. After the last meeting, I spawned in Navigation and went straight down to Storage. I haven't stepped foot in Medbay since before the last meeting (where I did see you around tick 10). 

Since you're lying about seeing me in Medbay to pad out your alibi, it makes me think you killed Eve in Oxygen and are just trying to pin it on Bob. Let's hear what Bob and Diana have to say, but right now Charlie is looking extremely suspicious to me for making up an alibi involving me.

Look, I'll be straight with you all. I started in upper engine working on tasks, then moved through to oxygen. When I walked into oxygen, Eve was already there — I actually saw her come in from upper engine right before me at around tick 15. I was barely in the room when Charlie burst in and immediately started pointing fingers.

Charlie, here's what bothers me: you reported the body the SECOND you walked in, before anyone could even react. And now Alice is calling out that your Medbay alibi is fabricated? That's a huge red flag. If you really came from Cafeteria into Oxygen, you would have had to pass through the corridor — meaning you could have just as easily killed Eve and then "discovered" the body when I happened to walk in, framing me as the convenient scapegoat.

I didn't kill Eve. I had no reason to, and the timing Charlie is describing doesn't even add up with his fake Medbay claim. Alice caught him in a lie, and a self-report with a fabricated alibi is classic Duck behavior. I want to hear what Diana has to say before voting, but right now Charlie is looking far more suspicious than me.

Hold on, Alice. Charlie isn't lying about starting in Medbay. I spawned in Cafeteria and was heading down to Medbay myself. At tick 13, I saw Charlie enter the Cafeteria coming directly from the Medbay corridor. He definitely started there and was moving exactly along the path he claimed (Medbay -> Cafeteria -> Oxygen). He probably just saw someone else or got confused about who was in Medbay, but his location alibi is absolutely real because I can physically vouch for it.

Because Charlie's route checks out perfectly with my own vision, his story about walking into Oxygen from Cafeteria makes total sense. Bob, you admit you were in Oxygen with Eve right around the time she died, and your main defense is that Charlie fabricated his entire starting location to cover a self-report. But I know for a fact Charlie didn't fabricate his starting location. 

Since Charlie is telling the truth about where he came from, it's highly likely he's also telling the truth about walking in on you next to the fresh body. This is LyLo (4 players left, 1 Duck), so we can't afford a mistake. Bob is caught red-handed here. I'm voting Bob.
Bob
Bob

Everyone slow down for one second, because Diana is doing some serious sleight of hand here.

Diana, you did NOT vouch that Charlie was in Medbay. You said you saw him "entering Cafeteria from the Medbay corridor at tick 13." That only proves he came from that corridor — it doesn't prove he was working in Medbay, and it absolutely doesn't address the actual lie Alice caught him in. Charlie didn't just claim he was in Medbay — he specifically claimed he SAW ALICE THERE. Alice has told us flat out she was in Navigation and Storage and never set foot in Medbay this round. That's a confirmed fabrication. Charlie invented a witness to pad his alibi. That is textbook Duck behavior, and Diana's "vouch" conveniently sidesteps the actual lie.

Now think about what Diana is really doing. She's swooping in at the perfect moment to rehabilitate Charlie's broken story right before the vote, on LyLo. That's not a Goose carefully analyzing — that's a partner running cover. I think Charlie and Diana are the Duck team, and Charlie self-reported because he knew Diana would back him up.

Here's my actual route again: I was in upper engine doing tasks, moved to oxygen. Eve walked into oxygen from upper engine right before me at tick 15 — she was alive when I arrived. Seconds later Charlie burst in and instantly reported. I had no time to kill her and no motive to dump a body in a room I was about to be caught in.

This is LyLo. If you vote me and I'm a Goose, you lose the game. The confirmed liar in this room is Charlie, with Diana suspiciously rushing to patch his story. Vote Charlie.

Bob, you just made a massive and fatal slip-up in your defense. You accused Charlie and me of being "the Duck team" working together. There is only ONE Duck in this entire game! We started with 5 Geese and 1 Duck. 

The fact that you are so desperate that you're inventing a multi-Duck conspiracy just to explain away why my actual vision confirms Charlie's route proves you are completely panicking. I know I am a Goose, and I know there's no "Duck team." Charlie probably just mistook a briefly rendered sprite or someone else for Alice in Medbay, but his physical path is undeniably real because I saw him walking it. 

You were caught standing over a fresh body, and now you're making up impossible team compositions to save your own skin. This is LyLo, and you've just proven you're the Duck. 

Bob
